appearances.title: Co-evolving the agent harness and the model lifts Qwen3.5-35B-A3B coding resolve rate from 57.8% to 64.8%
appearances.summary: A Microsoft-led paper alternates between letting the policy propose changes to its own harness from its failures and RL-training it under the chosen harness. The joint loop raises average resolve rate on three coding benchmarks from 57.8% to 64.8%, more than harness-only plus policy-only gains combined, and a frontier model can act as the harness proposer to transfer its judgment to a smaller mode
